question: Does training on rolling prices rather than only announcement-aligned windows establish useful out-of-sample price forecasting?
scaling: RMS fitted on GRID5 train and shared unchanged by both strides
selection: Lowest 20-minute MAE on common rolling-price validation
record: every optimizer-step minibatch loss and gradient norm
full-training and common-validation loss each epoch
Fed paired date-block comparisons after selection
budget: One GPU job, sequential stride comparisons, maximum 1 hour
comparison_scope: Training-population package, not an isolated sample-count effect
limitations: No text arm is retrained by this experiment
